item.title: Climate change drives wildfire risk and rising anxiety
item.description: Wildfire smoke covering Seattle and much of the West highlights the growing reach of destructive fires and the psychological toll they bring.

item.title: AI leaders declare onset of the singularity, marking a new era
item.description: Leading AI developers say their technology has reached a milestone once only imagined in science fiction: the singularity, when machines start to surpass human intelligence.

item.title: Immigration delays under Trump lead to surge in ICE arrest targets
item.description: A slowdown in immigration processing has caused a backlog in citizenship and permit applications, resulting in more people becoming targets for ICE arrests.

item.title: Schumer's route to majority hinges on winning over Democratic skeptics
item.description: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer sees a potential Democratic majority by 2027, but faces challenges from within his own caucus that could derail that path.
